prompt: A production Kubernetes cluster is running at 87% memory across all nodes. A critical security patch requires rolling restarts, but each restart temporarily spikes memory to 110% of the pod's request. Decide how to sequence the rollout so the patch lands today without triggering OOM kills on customer-facing services.

Two engineering teams independently built caching layers for the same backend service. Merging them would save infrastructure cost but risks a multi-week integration that blocks both teams' roadmaps. Decide whether to merge now, later, or never, and what information you need to commit to one path.

A startup has runway for 14 months but a competitor just raised a large round. The CEO wants to accelerate hiring, but the CTO argues that onboarding slows the existing team. Design a hiring plan that addresses both speed and velocity preservation.

A compliance audit revealed that 11% of production data lacks proper consent records. The legal team wants an immediate freeze on all data processing, but the product team says a freeze would breach SLAs with three enterprise clients. Propose a plan that satisfies both constraints.

A model fine-tuned on synthetic data performs well on the synthetic validation set but poorly on real user queries. You have budget for either collecting 500 real labeled examples or running a domain-adaptation technique that requires no new labels. Decide which path to take and what early signal would cause you to switch.

A database migration from PostgreSQL to a distributed NewSQL system is 60% complete. The remaining tables have complex foreign-key constraints that the new system handles differently. Continuing risks subtle data integrity bugs; rolling back wastes three months of work. Lay out criteria for the go/no-go decision.

An on-call engineer discovers that a rate limiter is silently dropping 2% of legitimate API requests during peak hours. Raising the limit risks exposing the service to abuse; keeping it risks losing paying customers. Propose a same-day mitigation and a longer-term fix.

A research team wants to submit a paper in 10 days, but the key ablation study requires a GPU cluster that is fully booked for 7 days. They can either run a smaller ablation on available hardware or negotiate for cluster time by delaying another team's work. Plan the path that maximizes paper strength without burning political capital.

A SaaS product's free tier is consuming 40% of infrastructure costs but drives 60% of paid conversions. Finance wants to cut the free tier; growth wants to expand it. Design an experiment that resolves the disagreement with data within 30 days.

A CI pipeline takes 47 minutes. Developers are batching commits to avoid waiting, which increases merge conflict rates. You can either parallelize the test suite (engineering cost) or split the monorepo (organizational cost). Decide which to pursue first and what metrics would validate the choice.

A deployed fraud detection model has a 0.3% false positive rate, but each false positive locks a legitimate customer's account for 24 hours. Lowering the threshold reduces false positives but lets more fraud through. Design a decision framework that accounts for both customer trust and financial loss.

A microservices architecture has 14 services, but observability shows that 80% of latency comes from a chain of 4 synchronous calls. Refactoring to async would fix latency but breaks the exactly-once delivery guarantee that finance depends on. Plan a migration that preserves the guarantee while reducing tail latency.

A team discovers that their A/B test has been running with a logging bug that drops 15% of events non-randomly — mobile users on slow connections are underrepresented. The test has been running for 3 weeks. Decide whether the results are salvageable and what analysis would confirm it.

A critical third-party API provider announces a 4x price increase effective in 60 days. Building an in-house replacement would take 90 days. Switching to a cheaper alternative would take 30 days but has fewer features. Plan a transition that avoids both service disruption and overspending.

An ML pipeline retrains nightly, but model drift detection fires 3-4 false alarms per week, causing alert fatigue. The team is considering raising the drift threshold, but the last real drift event was caught at the current threshold. Decide how to reduce false alarms without missing genuine drift.

A company's SOC 2 audit is in 6 weeks, but the engineering team just discovered that their secrets rotation policy has not been enforced for 8 months. Rotating all secrets at once risks outages; doing nothing risks audit failure. Plan the rotation sequence.

A product manager wants to ship a feature that uses user browsing history to personalize recommendations. The legal team flags GDPR concerns, and the privacy engineer says the anonymization pipeline is not yet production-ready. The feature is expected to increase engagement by 12%. Decide what to ship and when.

Two data centers serve traffic in active-active mode. One data center's cooling system is degrading, and the facility team estimates failure within 72 hours. Failing over all traffic to the other data center would exceed its capacity by 20% during peak hours. Plan the response.

A machine learning team is training a large model and discovers that 5% of the training data contains near-duplicate entries from the evaluation set. Removing them and retraining costs $40K in compute. Keeping them invalidates all published benchmarks. Decide the path forward.

An open-source library your product depends on just had its maintainer mass-delete all releases from the package registry in a protest action. Your CI/CD is broken, and your local cache has the last three versions. Plan immediate recovery and long-term resilience.

A feature flag system shows that a gradually rolled-out feature is causing a 7% increase in error rates for the 5% of users who have it enabled. But those same users show 15% higher retention. Decide whether to continue the rollout, pause, or roll back, and what additional data would change your decision.

A team of 8 engineers is split across 3 time zones. A critical production incident requires coordinated debugging, but it is midnight for 3 of the engineers and early morning for 2 others. Design an incident response protocol that is effective without burning out the team.

A government contract requires all data to remain within national borders, but the best-performing cloud region for latency is in a neighboring country. The compliant region has 3x the latency and 2x the cost. Plan an architecture that meets the legal requirement without destroying user experience.

A startup's runway is 8 months. The CTO proposes rewriting the backend in Rust for performance gains, estimating 4 months of work. The CEO argues the current Python backend is fast enough and engineering time should go to features. Decide how to arbitrate this with evidence rather than opinion.

An internal tool used by 200 employees has a known SQL injection vulnerability. Patching it requires refactoring the ORM layer, which will take 2 weeks. A WAF rule could block the attack vector immediately but would also block some legitimate queries. Decide the sequencing.

A recommendation system's click-through rate improved 8% after a change, but downstream purchase conversion dropped 3%. The product team celebrates the CTR win while the revenue team raises alarms. Design an analysis plan that identifies which metric should drive the decision.

A data warehouse query that generates the CEO's daily dashboard has grown from 2 minutes to 45 minutes over 6 months due to data volume growth. The options are: optimize the query, pre-aggregate data nightly, move to a columnar store, or reduce the dashboard scope. Decide the approach given a 1-week deadline.

An intern accidentally pushed AWS credentials to a public GitHub repository 4 hours ago. The credentials have been used to spin up crypto-mining instances in 3 regions. Plan the incident response covering immediate containment, forensics, cost mitigation, and process changes.

A clinical trial data pipeline must produce results for a regulatory submission in 48 hours. A statistician discovers that one site's data has systematic measurement bias. Including it may bias results; excluding it reduces statistical power below the pre-registered threshold. Decide the analytical strategy.

A mobile app update reduced crash rates by 40% but increased battery drain by 25%. App store reviews are improving due to stability, but power users are complaining about battery life. Decide whether to release a hotfix, revert, or ship as-is with a settings toggle.

A team maintaining a monolith wants to extract a payments microservice. The monolith has 340 direct database queries against the payments tables from 12 different modules. Propose a strangler-fig migration plan that avoids a feature freeze and maintains transaction consistency.

A machine learning model serves real-time predictions with a p99 latency of 50ms. A new regulation requires all predictions to include an explanation. The cheapest explanation method adds 200ms of latency. Decide how to comply without breaking latency SLAs.

A hedge fund's backtesting framework shows a strategy with 18% annual returns, but live paper-trading shows only 4%. The quant team suspects slippage modeling is wrong, but fixing it might invalidate 6 months of research. Plan the investigation and decide when to stop the live test.

A DevOps team manages 300 servers with Ansible playbooks that have grown organically over 3 years. No one fully understands the dependency graph, and a recent change broke 40 servers. The team can either freeze changes and audit, or continue shipping with extra manual testing. Decide the approach.

A SaaS company discovers that their largest customer, responsible for 30% of revenue, is using the product in a way that violates the Terms of Service and may expose the company to legal liability. Cutting them off immediately threatens the company's financial health. Plan the response.

A real-time bidding system processes 500K requests per second. A new privacy regulation requires checking each request against a consent database before bidding. The consent database can handle 100K reads per second. Design a system that complies without dropping 80% of bid opportunities.

A research team has two promising approaches for a conference deadline in 3 weeks. Approach A has stronger theoretical backing but only preliminary results. Approach B has solid empirical results but a weaker story. There is only enough compute and writing bandwidth for one paper. Decide which to pursue.

A deployment accidentally wrote production data to a staging database for 6 hours. Both databases now have divergent records. The staging database has already been used by QA to validate the next release. Plan data reconciliation without blocking either the production fix or the upcoming release.

An autonomous vehicle fleet operator discovers that the perception model performs 15% worse in rain but the safety certification was based on dry-weather testing. Pulling the fleet off the road costs $2M per week in lost revenue. Continuing operation in rain risks an incident. Decide on operational constraints and a testing plan.

A team lead has two senior engineers who disagree fundamentally about the system architecture. One wants event sourcing; the other wants traditional CRUD with change-data-capture. The disagreement is blocking a key project. Design a technical decision process that resolves this within one week without alienating either engineer.

A financial services company must migrate from an end-of-life mainframe to cloud infrastructure. The mainframe runs COBOL batch jobs that produce regulatory reports due monthly. The next report is due in 18 days. Plan the migration so the regulatory deadline is met even if the cloud system is not fully ready.

A content moderation AI flags 5% of legitimate posts as violations, causing user complaints. Reducing sensitivity lets harmful content through. The platform is under regulatory scrutiny for both over-moderation and under-moderation simultaneously. Design a system that addresses both failure modes.

A distributed team uses 5 different observability tools due to historical acquisitions. The monthly cost is $180K combined. Consolidating to one tool would save $120K/year but requires 3 months of migration during which monitoring coverage will have gaps. Decide the migration strategy.

A chip design team discovers a timing violation in their ASIC 2 weeks before tape-out. The fix requires re-routing a critical path, which could take 1-4 weeks depending on complexity. Delaying tape-out costs $500K per week. Shipping with the violation risks a respin costing $2M. Decide the path.

An e-commerce platform's search relevance team improved their ranking model, but the improved model surfaces more long-tail products. This increases search quality metrics but decreases ad revenue because long-tail products have lower ad bids. Plan how to resolve the conflict between search quality and ad revenue.

A hospital's EHR system needs a security patch, but applying it requires 4 hours of downtime. The hospital cannot go offline for 4 hours without patient safety risk. The patch fixes a vulnerability that has a known exploit in the wild. Decide the maintenance window strategy.

A video game studio is 3 months from launch and discovers that their netcode has a desync bug that occurs in 1-in-500 matches. Fixing it requires rewriting the state reconciliation layer. Shipping with the bug will result in bad reviews. Delaying launch costs $1.5M per month. Plan the response.

A company's SSO provider had a security breach. All employee sessions must be invalidated, but doing so during business hours would lock out 2,000 employees simultaneously, including the support team handling a major customer escalation. Plan the session rotation.

A climate research team's simulation uses a legacy Fortran solver that is the only implementation of their novel equations. The solver runs on hardware being decommissioned in 6 months. Porting to modern hardware requires either rewriting in C++ or using an automatic transpiler with known accuracy issues. Plan the transition.

A logistics company's route optimization algorithm minimizes fuel cost, but drivers complain that the routes are unpredictable and stressful. Driver turnover has increased 20% since deploying the algorithm. Decide how to balance algorithmic efficiency against driver satisfaction without reverting to manual routing.

A team discovers that their feature store has been serving stale features for 12% of predictions over the past month due to a cache invalidation bug. All model performance metrics during this period are suspect. Decide how to assess the true impact and whether affected models need retraining.

A supply chain platform must onboard a new supplier whose data format is incompatible with the existing schema. Building a custom adapter takes 4 weeks, but the supplier's products are needed in 2 weeks for a seasonal demand spike. The supplier cannot change their format. Plan a solution that meets the timeline.

A quantum computing startup's error correction code works in simulation but fails on real hardware due to crosstalk between qubits. They have access to the hardware for only 8 hours per week. Design an experimental plan that maximizes diagnostic information per hardware session.

A platform team wants to deprecate an internal API that 45 services depend on. The replacement API is ready but has different semantics for error handling. Forcing migration risks breaking services; allowing indefinite dual-maintenance wastes engineering resources. Plan a deprecation timeline.

A cybersecurity team detects an active intrusion in a network segment that hosts both production servers and a honeypot. Isolating the segment stops the attacker but also takes down production. Leaving it open allows intelligence gathering but risks lateral movement. Decide the containment strategy.

A pharmaceutical company's drug discovery pipeline found a compound that shows efficacy in two indications. Pursuing both in parallel doubles the clinical trial budget. Choosing one risks missing the larger market. The patent clock is ticking. Design the portfolio decision framework.

A media streaming service notices that their CDN costs spike 3x during live events, but pre-purchasing reserved capacity for peak would waste 70% of it during normal hours. Design a capacity strategy that handles spikes without chronic over-provisioning.

A robotics team's SLAM algorithm works indoors but fails outdoors due to GPS drift and visual feature sparsity. A conference demo is in 2 weeks, and the venue is outdoor. They can either constrain the demo to a small well-mapped area or attempt a sensor fusion fix. Decide the approach and fallback plan.

A fintech company's KYC verification rejects 30% of legitimate applicants from developing countries because their ID documents don't match the template database. Adding more templates requires 3 months of data collection. The company is losing market share to competitors who accept more document types. Plan an interim solution.

A CI system uses flaky end-to-end tests that fail 8% of the time due to timing issues. Developers re-run failed pipelines routinely, costing 15% of CI compute. Removing the flaky tests risks missing real bugs. Fixing each test individually would take months. Propose a systematic approach.

An ML team discovers that their dataset has a label bias: annotators from one region systematically rate sentiment more positively than another region. The model has already been deployed for 2 months. Decide how to quantify the impact on production predictions and whether a recall of past results is necessary.

A renewable energy grid operator needs to balance supply from intermittent solar and wind sources with demand that peaks at sunset when solar drops. Battery storage covers 60% of the gap, but a heatwave is forecast that will push demand 25% above normal. Plan the energy dispatch strategy for the next 72 hours.

A software vendor's on-premise customers are 4 major versions behind the current release. Supporting old versions consumes 35% of engineering capacity. Forcing upgrades risks losing customers to competitors who support longer. Decide a version support policy that balances engineering efficiency with customer retention.

A trading firm's risk engine calculates Value-at-Risk in a batch process that finishes at 7 AM. Regulatory reporting requires submission by 8 AM. The batch has been creeping later due to portfolio growth and now finishes at 7:45 AM. The fix requires either algorithmic optimization, hardware scaling, or approximation methods. Decide the approach.

A self-driving car company's simulation suite covers 10 million scenarios, but a fatal edge case was found in production that none of the simulations captured. Adding adversarial scenario generation could prevent future gaps but slows simulation throughput by 40%. Decide how to integrate adversarial scenarios without falling behind on regression testing.

A tech company's employee engagement survey reveals that the platform team has 40% lower satisfaction than other teams. The platform team maintains critical infrastructure and losing members would be catastrophic. The team lead attributes it to boring work; HR attributes it to management style. Design an investigation that identifies the real cause within 2 weeks.

A distributed database cluster experiences a network partition during a multi-region deployment. Region A has the write master but stale replicas; Region B has up-to-date replicas but no write capability. Customer transactions are failing in both regions. Decide how to restore service while minimizing data loss.

A biotech startup has promising gene therapy results in mice but needs to decide between a Phase 1 human trial (18 months, $15M) and licensing the technology to a pharma company (immediate revenue but loss of control). The patent expires in 8 years. Frame the decision analysis.

An ad-tech company discovers that 20% of their attributed conversions are likely fraudulent click injections. Reporting this to advertisers would reduce revenue and trust. Not reporting it risks legal action if discovered later. The fraud detection system needs 6 weeks to reach production quality. Plan the disclosure and remediation timeline.

A warehouse automation system's path-planning algorithm occasionally creates deadlocks where 4 or more robots block each other. Each deadlock takes 3 minutes of manual intervention to resolve. The algorithm works perfectly for 3 or fewer robots in the same zone. Decide between zone capacity limits, deadlock detection and recovery, or a new planning algorithm.

A space mission's flight software has a confirmed bug that causes a 0.1% chance of sensor data corruption per orbit. The satellite is already in orbit and can receive software updates, but each update attempt has a 2% chance of bricking the satellite. The mission has 3 years of planned operation remaining. Decide whether to patch.

A machine learning platform team needs to migrate from TensorFlow 1.x to PyTorch. There are 47 production models in TF1.x, and the team has 3 ML engineers. Converting each model takes roughly 1 week including validation. Meanwhile, new model development is blocked on the old framework. Plan the migration to minimize total business impact.

A social media platform detects a coordinated inauthentic behavior campaign 48 hours before a national election. Removing the accounts would trigger accusations of censorship; leaving them up enables misinformation. The campaign uses a mix of real and fake accounts that are hard to separate. Decide the intervention strategy.

A construction company's project management software shows that 3 out of 5 active projects are behind schedule. The shared crane and concrete crew are bottlenecks. Accelerating any one project by adding overtime delays another. Determine which project to prioritize and what the decision criteria should be.

A language model serving infrastructure handles 10K requests per second. A new safety filter must be applied to every response, adding 80ms of latency. Batching the filter improves throughput but increases p99 latency from 200ms to 600ms. Running the filter asynchronously risks serving unfiltered responses for a brief window. Choose an architecture.

A data team discovers that the warehouse ETL has been silently truncating decimal precision for 4 months, rounding financial figures to the nearest dollar instead of cent. Downstream dashboards and reports were used for strategic decisions during this period. Plan the data recovery, stakeholder communication, and prevention strategy.

A drone delivery startup must choose between two coverage expansion strategies: adding 5 small depots across a metro area (lower per-depot cost, complex logistics) or 1 large central depot with longer-range drones (simpler logistics, higher per-delivery cost). Regulatory approval timelines differ for each approach. Design the decision analysis.

A compiler team finds that their new optimization pass improves performance by 12% on benchmarks but introduces a miscompilation bug that affects 1 in 50,000 functions. The bug corrupts output silently. The optimization pass took 6 months to build. Decide whether to ship with a conservative heuristic, invest in formal verification, or shelve the pass.

An insurance company's pricing model uses 47 features, but a fairness audit reveals that 3 features are highly correlated with protected characteristics. Removing them drops pricing accuracy by 8%, leading to either higher premiums for all or increased loss ratios. Design an approach that maintains actuarial soundness while satisfying fairness requirements.

A multiplayer game's matchmaking algorithm optimizes for skill balance, but players complain about long queue times. Relaxing the skill threshold reduces wait times but creates lopsided matches that drive player churn. The game's concurrent population varies 5x between peak and off-peak. Design an adaptive matchmaking strategy.

A research hospital's imaging AI detects potential tumors with 95% sensitivity but only 70% specificity, generating many false positives that overwhelm radiologists with extra reads. Increasing the specificity threshold to 85% would miss 5% of real tumors. Decide how to deploy the system in a way that helps rather than hinders the radiology workflow.

A semiconductor fab discovers contamination in one of its cleanrooms. Production must halt for decontamination, but 3 customer orders are due in 10 days. Shifting production to another fab line is possible but requires requalification that takes 5 days. Some orders have contractual penalty clauses. Plan the production recovery.

A school district is deploying AI-powered tutoring software. Teachers report it helps struggling students but bores advanced students, who disengage entirely. The vendor's adaptive difficulty feature is not working as advertised. The district paid for a full-year license. Decide whether to continue, supplement, or replace the software mid-year.

A payments company processes transactions in 23 currencies. A new anti-money-laundering rule requires real-time conversion to a base currency for threshold checking, but exchange rate APIs have 500ms latency and occasional failures. Using stale rates risks compliance violations; waiting for fresh rates risks transaction timeouts. Design the rate management strategy.

A machine learning team's model registry has 230 registered models, but only 40 are actively serving traffic. The remaining models have no documented owners and uncertain deprecation status. Deleting unused models saves storage and reduces confusion, but some may be needed for regulatory audit trails. Plan the cleanup.

A city's emergency dispatch system routes ambulances using historical response time data. A new hospital opened 3 months ago, changing optimal routing, but the system hasn't been recalibrated. Updating the model requires 2 weeks of data collection from the new hospital. In the interim, some neighborhoods have suboptimal response times. Plan the transition.

A SaaS company's multi-tenant architecture shares a single database. One customer's analytics queries are causing lock contention that degrades performance for all tenants. Migrating that customer to a dedicated instance takes 2 weeks. Throttling their queries would violate their enterprise SLA. Design an immediate mitigation.

A deepfake detection system deployed by a news organization flags 12% of legitimate videos as manipulated. Lowering sensitivity lets actual deepfakes through. Publishing a retraction for a falsely flagged video damages credibility. Not catching a real deepfake damages credibility more. Design the editorial workflow around the detector's limitations.

A manufacturing plant's predictive maintenance model correctly predicted 3 out of 4 recent equipment failures but also generated 15 false alarms. Each false alarm costs $8K in unnecessary downtime for inspection. Each missed failure costs $200K in unplanned downtime. Determine the optimal alert threshold and maintenance scheduling policy.

A language model API provider wants to add usage-based pricing but has customers on flat-rate plans who would see 3x cost increases. Grandfathering old plans indefinitely loses revenue; forcing migration risks churn. The top 5% of users consume 60% of compute. Design a pricing transition that retains customers while improving unit economics.

A satellite constellation operator discovers that two satellites in adjacent orbital planes have a projected close approach in 96 hours. Maneuvering either satellite uses propellant that reduces mission lifetime by 2 months. Not maneuvering has a 1-in-10,000 collision probability. Decide the maneuver criteria and timing.

A cross-functional team must deliver an MVP in 8 weeks. The designer wants a polished UI, the backend engineer wants a robust API, and the data scientist wants a well-validated model. Doing all three properly would take 14 weeks. Decide what to cut, what to defer, and what quality bar each component must meet for a credible demo.

A bank's fraud detection model was trained on data from before a pandemic-era shift in spending patterns. Post-pandemic, normal transactions look anomalous and fraud patterns changed. Retraining on recent data alone loses pre-pandemic fraud signatures. Using all data dilutes recent patterns. Design the retraining strategy.

An autonomous mining operation's fleet management system optimizes for ore throughput, but operators report it creates dangerous traffic patterns at intersections. Slowing vehicles at intersections reduces throughput by 15%. Adding more intersection infrastructure costs $2M and takes 6 months. Design an interim safety solution.

A security team discovers a zero-day vulnerability in a library used by 80% of the company's microservices. Patching all services simultaneously is impossible due to testing requirements. Prioritizing by exposure creates a 2-week window where unpatched services are known-vulnerable. An attacker is actively scanning for the vulnerability. Plan the patching sequence and interim protections.

A research lab's compute cluster is shared between training runs and interactive notebook users. Training jobs are long-running and preemptible; notebook users need immediate GPU access for debugging. The cluster is at 95% utilization. Adding a priority queue for notebooks would preempt training jobs, extending their completion time. Removing notebook access would slow research iteration. Design a resource allocation policy that balances both needs.
